contextual_terms.source: \PN took \v[3] back from Liza.
contextual_terms.reason: 從培育者取回寶可夢的事件；與綠嶺道館館主Liza（小南）分開。

contextual_terms.source: \PN teamed up with Royal!\me[Item get]\wtnp[40]
contextual_terms.reason: 皇家蒙面人的住處組隊事件；與Royal Avenue（皇家大道）分開。

contextual_terms.source: Daisy: We run the Gym here.
contextual_terms.reason: 華藍道館三姊妹的發言；不套用到其他同名人物。

contextual_terms.source: Lily: We run the Gym here.
contextual_terms.reason: 華藍道館三姊妹的發言。

contextual_terms.source: Violet: We run the Gym here.
contextual_terms.reason: 華藍道館三姊妹的發言；與Violet City（桔梗市）分開。

contextual_terms.source: \bAaron: Hello! It's good to meet you! I should explain that I'm a huge fan of bugs.
contextual_terms.reason: 這組對話指神奧的蟲屬性四天王；不套用到同英文名的波導勇者亞朗等人物。

contextual_terms.source: \bDrake: Are you ready, kid? It's about to get interesting.
contextual_terms.reason: 柑橘競技場事件，橘子聯盟館主。

contextual_terms.source: \bDrake: Don't think my age has slowed me down.
contextual_terms.reason: 同地圖另一個Drake事件為LEADER_Drake；依實際訓練家類型區分。

contextual_terms.source: \bDrake: Close battle earlier. I know you'll beat the rest.
contextual_terms.reason: 宮門競技場此事件沿用勇次的圖像，不是源治的trchar172。

contextual_terms.source: \bDrake: Let's see what two champions can do.
contextual_terms.reason: 原版Map881同時存在兩位Drake，此事件為橘子聯盟館主，不是四天王。

contextual_terms.source: \bDrake: Perhaps you are a strong Trainer? Oh, seven badges from Hoenn. You might even be a challenge.
contextual_terms.reason: 豐緣地區事件，圖像與ELITEFOUR_Drake相同。

contextual_terms.source: \bFlint: That was a great battle! What do you think, Volkner? Give the kid a try.
contextual_terms.reason: 與電次相關的神奧四天王對話；不套用到英文同名的小剛父親武能。

contextual_terms.en: Foul Play at A Garbodor Price
contextual_terms.zh-TW: Foul Play at A Garbodor Price
contextual_terms.source: \bFoul: Hello! Glad to see that you are finally here. In case you don't recognise me, my name is Foul Play at A Garbodor Price, but my friends call me Foul.
contextual_terms.reason: 製作者客串的完整網名保留原寫法；只對此句暱稱範圍排除寶可夢名稱檢查，其他文字照常檢查。

contextual_terms.source: Credits
contextual_terms.reason: 標題選單的製作名單；與輝煌俱樂部貨幣Credits（點數）分開。

contextual_terms.source: \bI think Scott was recruiting in Viridian City. Maybe you can catch him before it's too late.
contextual_terms.reason: 與對戰開拓區招募相關的亞希達；不套用到其他同英文名訓練家。

contextual_terms.source: GC Credits
contextual_terms.reason: 強化商店選項中的輝煌俱樂部點數簡稱，保留選項寬度；完整概念不變。

contextual_terms.source: \bKukui: Looking good, cousin.
contextual_terms.reason: 庫庫伊的阿羅拉口語招呼，不代表親屬；與大木博士的親戚Samson分開。

contextual_terms.source: \bKukui: Excited? I am! The first round is a Battle Royale. Be one of the last 16 standing to move on.
contextual_terms.reason: 瑪納羅大會預賽的大型淘汰混戰；與皇家大道的四方Battle Royal（皇家對戰）區分。

contextual_terms.source: \bKukui: Welcome, everyone, to the Alola League's first round - the Battle Royal!
contextual_terms.reason: 明示為瑪納羅大會首輪多人淘汰賽，不是四方皇家對戰。

contextual_terms.source: \bKukui: You're back. The Masked Royal wants to have a battle with you. He told me to tell you to meet him at the Royal Avenue Battle Dome.
contextual_terms.reason: 皇家大道的Battle Royal Dome，不是希爾斯的對戰巨蛋。

contextual_terms.source: \bRudy: So this was your third badge? You're almost ready to challenge Drake.
contextual_terms.reason: 橘子聯盟館主阿義談第三枚徽章，指橘子聯盟首席勇次，並非豐緣四天王源治。

contextual_terms.source: \bThing is, there's no such thing as a "perfect lead". You could lead off with a Ferrothorn and it would do amazing against Marlon, but then it would get one shot from any of Flint's Pokémon.
contextual_terms.reason: 草鋼堅果啞鈴會被火屬性四天王隊伍克制，指大葉，並非小剛父親武能。

contextual_terms.source: \bThis is where challengers may face Drake after obtaining the four badges.
contextual_terms.reason: messages.dat 地圖246，柑橘島，取得四枚橘子聯盟徽章後挑戰勇次。

contextual_terms.source: \bThis is where the Battle Royale takes place.
contextual_terms.reason: messages.dat 地圖958，阿羅拉聯盟首輪，與同圖庫庫伊決賽及八強說明相鄰，並非皇家大道皇家對戰。

contextual_terms.source: \bVolkner and Flint of the Elite Four are good friends.
contextual_terms.reason: 明示四天王，且是電次好友，指大葉。

contextual_terms.source: \bWhy not fight me? It may just inspire my friend to give it another go. By the way. I'm Flint, an Elite Four member.
contextual_terms.reason: 原文明示四天王成員，指大葉。

contextual_terms.source: \bYou are not registered to fight Drake.
contextual_terms.reason: 橘子聯盟挑戰登記台詞，與取得四徽章挑戰勇次的說明一致。

contextual_terms.source: \bYou're gonna fight Drake!?\nWow!!!
contextual_terms.reason: 橘子聯盟挑戰者對話，指勇次。

contextual_terms.source: \rDaisy: Hi, \PN!
contextual_terms.reason: 地圖8梳毛服務事件，為小茂姐姐奈奈美，並非華藍三姐妹櫻花。

contextual_terms.source: \rDaisy: Oh, okay then.
contextual_terms.reason: 地圖8同一梳毛服務事件。

contextual_terms.source: \rDaisy: There!  \v[2] looks a lot happier and prettier now!
contextual_terms.reason: 地圖8梳毛服務完成台詞。

contextual_terms.source: \rDaisy: Which Pokémon do you want me to groom?
contextual_terms.reason: 地圖8梳毛服務選擇台詞。

contextual_terms.source: \rDaisy: Would you like me to groom one of your Pokémon?
contextual_terms.reason: 地圖8梳毛服務邀請台詞。

contextual_terms.source: \rIvy
contextual_terms.reason: Map394 event12 名稱Pokemon，角色圖IVYSAUR，為妙蛙草叫聲，並非內木博士。

contextual_terms.source: \rLil
contextual_terms.reason: Map390 event106名Lilligant，角色圖LILLIGANT，為寶可夢叫聲，非一般人名Lil。

contextual_terms.source: \rLiza: Go away. No one is allowed in this sacred land.
contextual_terms.reason: Map269噴火龍山谷，守護聖地的紀珂。

contextual_terms.source: \rLiza: Hello again \PN. Nice to see you.
contextual_terms.reason: Map342、473、500噴火龍領回事件的紀珂，並非小南。

contextual_terms.source: \rLiza: You have a strong Charizard. How would you like me to train one of your Pokémon?
contextual_terms.reason: Map269噴火龍山谷訓練服務。

contextual_terms.source: \rLiza: You think you're good enough to enter this place? Just try it.
contextual_terms.reason: Map269噴火龍山谷的入場對戰。

contextual_terms.source: \rLiza: TM03 contains Psyshock.
contextual_terms.reason: Map442綠嶺道館，小楓與小南的雙打對戰。

contextual_terms.source: \rLiza: The place is a lot of fun.
contextual_terms.reason: Map442綠嶺道館，小南。

contextual_terms.source: \rLiza: We battle in cooperation.
contextual_terms.reason: Map442綠嶺道館，小南。

contextual_terms.source: \rLiza: You'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
contextual_terms.reason: Map442綠嶺道館雙打要求。

contextual_terms.source: \rLuana: You may just beat Drake. Good luck!
contextual_terms.reason: 橘子聯盟館主琉麗談橘子聯盟首席勇次。

contextual_terms.source: \rMara
contextual_terms.reason: Map686 event60角色圖MARACTUS，為沙鈴仙人掌叫聲。

contextual_terms.source: \rMin?
contextual_terms.reason: Map677 event152角色圖MINCCINO shiny，為異色泡沫栗鼠叫聲。

contextual_terms.source: \rOk then... well, we've changed the format a little bit, being that the Battle Royale ends when there's 32 contestants left, instead of 16.
contextual_terms.reason: 阿羅拉聯盟首輪多人生存賽，晉級人數由16改32，非四方皇家對戰。

contextual_terms.reason: Map551 events52、53，角色圖PACHIRISU。
